There's just one thing that bugs me the most; after you level up your plants, it only summons pets that are the level of your plant and there's no way to bring your plant back to a lower level. reviews.title: Lack of Transparency
reviews.text: This is a PAID app.  Not a free “with in-app purchases” app.  But they won’t tell you it’s paid until AFTER you spill your guts about all your deepest anxieties.  It felt like a betrayal to be solicited for cash the MOMENT I’d finished reflecting on my mental health.  If I’d known that this is the app’s business model up front, I would never have downloaded this app (and wouldn’t be so upset), but instead I feel disrespected and lied to.

reviews.title: Found at the right time!
reviews.text:
I seriously love this app so much!

I came across dungeons first and since I was having alot of fun with that I decided to see if the silly little voids had any other games. I was surprised to find a mental health app! I’ve been meaning to give one a try but no others have caught my attention, but this one did! Ive been using it for three days at this point so it’s hard to say Ive noticed any changes but I do know Ive actually been remembering to drink more water now its really nice to have the resources I do now in this app-

Thank you so much for letting it be free!! The ONLY gripes I have with this app is when it comes to the AI (I assume) chat and battle aspects of it.

Having an AI chat on a mental health app where others may already be struggling and why they turned to this app may seem like a good idea but with what we know about AI now, not even just for the sake of the environment, can be extremely damaging to peoples mental health as well! And frankly seems risky to be included here-

The battling, while fun and keeps me from overthinking- I did notice when you upgrade your moves to gold and the animation plays, any background media stops. For me, I tend to listen to music alot as it helps me relax but if I enter a battle and even look at a gold card move it pauses it, and sadly it does it every time!

TLDR: For being a free mental health app the resources it has in app are amazing! The inclusion of an AI chat is weird considering what AI is proven to do to both the environment and peoples mental health- but besides that I find myself retreating to the battle area alot when feeling overwhelmed to distract me so I would extremely appreciate it if you could make gold moves not stop my music! Thank you so much for your time! 🖤

reviews.title: Amazing app but I have some suggestions ^^
reviews.text:
I love this game sooooo much, i have an entire month filled out in my calendar, i have giga, and i have lots of good voidpets. This game has been helping me a lot, but i have some recommendations. 

First of all, id like the stickers to not only be of the voidpets. It would be nice to have stickers of stars, or circles of the sorts. To make it better, sticker rotation would be a nice option for customization. 

There could also be an option to have music during battles like in the dungeon game, and an option to mute it either through settings or a button in the battles. I don't mind which one. 

A good addition would also be hourly missions, which give less than the daily missions. I typically log on every hour or so to check my garden, and it'd be nice to have more things to do, like cuddling a voidpet for a few seconds, watering a plant with plain water, and so on.

Like in the dungeon game, the voidpets greed, sloth, and lust could have higher forms, obtainable in the same way as in the dungeon game; Dream reapers and Cosmic truffles.

Staying on the category of vivids, it would be a nice addition to add holiday vivids, like the holiday vivid in the dungeon game from last year. I loved that a lot.

I love the level of care put into both voidpet games, and again, the app is actually engaging me to take care of myself better. 

Thanks for reading, and take care!! ^^

reviews.title: Contains a beta generative chat AI feature
reviews.text:
To start, I was falling in love with this game, it’s cute, and I do like how relaxed it is and promotes you to check in on yourself + I generally really like the design of these guys. However, morally I don’t really stand with the prevalence of AI features within everything recently and how unnecessary they are and taxing to the environment. Notably, in mental health settings, AI chatbots have caused issues pertaining to advice as well as create an unhealthy parasocial dynamic between users and said AI. I think when it comes to socialization, users should be encouraged to seek interaction more meaningfully between other individuals. 

I’d be a bit more relaxed on this if there was a feature allowing you to turn it off, but playing this knowing the feature is supported in the first place isn’t really comfortable for me and I’m not sure whether I’ll continue playing due to it. I had friends who were willing to be referred as well, but declined upon finding this out.
